data.one_liner: Limits content size for Flutter Web and Desktop applications.
data.what_it_does: It wraps your app to constrain its maximum size and frame it on large devices such as web browsers or desktop screens. This keeps non-responsive apps focused on a specific content area with a customizable background for the whitespace.
use_when: You are building a Flutter Web or Desktop app that is not yet fully responsive
You want to constrain your app UI to a mobile-like frame size on large screens
avoid_when: Your application already has a fully responsive design built for all screen sizes
You need native desktop window management features
strengths: Quickly makes non-responsive apps look focused on large screens
Customizable maximum size, background color, and enable/disable toggle
weaknesses: Not documented with extensive configuration options beyond basic sizing and background color
Does not replace a proper responsive layout design
